/// å¨å±èæµï¼åæºè¯·æ±è³å°é´é gap_msï¼é¿åè§¦åéæµ
fn throttle(slot: &'static Mutex<Option<Instant>>, gap_ms: u64) {
    let mut guard = slot.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if let Some(prev) = *guard {
        if let Some(left) = Duration::from_millis(gap_ms).checked_sub(prev.elapsed()) {
            if !left.is_zero() {
                std::thread::sleep(left);
            }
        }
    }
    *guard = Some(Instant::now());
}

}

function reduceEvent(state, event) {

function buildCheckpoints(events, stride = 50) {
  let state = initialState();
  const points = [{ at: -Infinity, index: 0, state }];
  events.forEach((event, i) => {
    state = reduceEvent(state, event);
    if ((i + 1) % stride === 0) {
      points.push({ at: event.at, index: i + 1, state });
    }
  });
  return points;
}

const checkpoints = buildCheckpoints(history);

function stateAt(time) {
  let left = 0, right = checkpoints.length - 1;
  while (left < right) {
    const mid = Math.ceil((left + right) / 2);
    if (checkpoints[mid].at <= time) left = mid;
    else right = mid - 1;
  }
  const base = checkpoints[left];
  let state = structuredClone(base.state);
  for (let i = base.index; i < history.length && history[i].at <= time; i++) {
    state = reduceEvent(state, history[i]);
  }
  return state;
}

function renderState(state) {
  for (const [id, object] of alarmObjects) {

  for (const [id, object] of passageObjects) {

  for (const [id, object] of personObjects) {
    const position = state.people[id];
    object.visible = Array.isArray(position);
    if (position) object.position.fromArray(position);

}

let frame = 0, cursor = 0;
const endTime = history.at(-1)?.at ?? 0;

function pause() {

function play(rate = 1) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(rate) || rate <= 0) return;
  pause();
  const start = performance.now(), from = cursor;
  function tick(now) {
    cursor = Math.min(endTime, from + (now - start) * rate);
    renderState(stateAt(cursor));
    if (cursor < endTime) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

using lib60870;
using lib60870.CS101;
using lib60870.CS104;

public class Iec104ServerApp
{
    private Server _server;
    private readonly int _commonAddress = 1;

    public void Start()
    {
        _server = new Server();
        _server.DebugOutput = false;
        _server.SetASDUReceivedHandler(OnAsduReceived, null);
        _server.Start();
        Console.WriteLine("IEC 104 æå¡ç«¯å·²å¯å¨ï¼ç«¯å£ 2404");
    }

    private bool OnAsduReceived(object parameter, ASDU asdu)
    {
        switch (asdu.TypeId)
        {
            case TypeID.C_IC_NA_1:
                HandleInterrogation(asdu);
                return true;
            case TypeID.C_SC_NA_1:
                HandleSingleCommand(asdu);
                return true;
            default:
                Console.WriteLine($"æªå¤çç±»å: {asdu.TypeId}");
                return true;
        }
    }

    private void HandleInterrogation(ASDU request)
    {
        // ååæ¿æ´»ç¡®è®¤
        var actCon = new ASDU(
            request.TypeId,
            CauseOfTransmission.ACTIVATION_CON,
            false, false,
            request.CommonAddress,
            request.CauseOfTransmission,
            false);
        actCon.AddInformationObject(new InterrogationCommand(0, 20));
        _server.EnqueueASDU(actCon);

        // ä¸éé¥ä¿¡
        var spiAsdu = new ASDU(
            TypeID.M_SP_NA_1,
            CauseOfTransmission.INTERROGATED_BY_STATION,
            false, false,
            _commonAddress,
            0, false);
        spiAsdu.AddInformationObject(
            new SinglePointInformation(1001, true, QualityDescriptor.GOOD));
        spiAsdu.AddInformationObject(
            new SinglePointInformation(1002, false, QualityDescriptor.GOOD));
        _server.EnqueueASDU(spiAsdu);

        // ä¸éé¥æµ
        var measAsdu = new ASDU(
            TypeID.M_ME_NC_1,
            CauseOfTransmission.INTERROGATED_BY_STATION,
            false, false,
            _commonAddress,
            0, false);
        measAsdu.AddInformationObject(
            new MeasuredValueShort(2001, 220.5f, QualityDescriptor.GOOD));
        measAsdu.AddInformationObject(
            new MeasuredValueShort(2002, 50.02f, QualityDescriptor.GOOD));
        _server.EnqueueASDU(measAsdu);

        // æ»å¬å¤ç»æï¼è¿ä¸ªå«æ¼
        var actTerm = new ASDU(
            request.TypeId,
            CauseOfTransmission.ACTIVATION_TERMINATION,
            false, false,
            request.CommonAddress,
            0, false);
        actTerm.AddInformationObject(new InterrogationCommand(0, 20));
        _server.EnqueueASDU(actTerm);
    }

    private void HandleSingleCommand(ASDU command)
    {
        var sc = (SingleCommand)command.GetElement(0);
        bool isSelect = sc.Select;

        var con = new ASDU(
            TypeID.C_SC_NA_1,
            CauseOfTransmission.ACTIVATION_CON,
            false, false,
            command.CommonAddress,
            0, false);
        con.AddInformationObject(
            new SingleCommand(sc.ObjectAddress, sc.State, isSelect, 0));
        _server.EnqueueASDU(con);

        if (!isSelect)
        {
            SendSpontaneousSinglePoint(sc.ObjectAddress, sc.State);
        }
    }

    public void SendSpontaneousSinglePoint(int ioa, bool value)
    {
        var asdu = new ASDU(
            TypeID.M_SP_NA_1,
            CauseOfTransmission.SPONTANEOUS,
            false, false,
            _commonAddress,
            0, false);
        asdu.AddInformationObject(
            new SinglePointInformation(ioa, value, QualityDescriptor.GOOD));
        _server.EnqueueASDU(asdu);
    }
}

using lib60870;

            case TypeID.C_SC_NA_1:

    public void SendGeneralInterrogation()
